sources.quote: Rho Boötis, Latinised from ρ Boötis and formally named Kalasungsang, is a single, orange-hued star in the northern constellation of Boötes.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 124 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,350 K, so 19.67 solar radii.
